tool_call_story._about: Content of the reference request's two tool calls (Part 06). Fictional companies and prices; Parts 07 and 08 can reuse them so the story stays consistent.

competitor_names.note: Fictional names of the three main competitors named in the user's Q3 report. No real company is meant.

value: Birchline pricing plans list price per user
Cedar Systems pricing per seat per month
search_queries.note: The three queries the model writes into its pass-1 web_search call (count = hypothetical.reference_request.web_queries).

recency_days.note: The model asks for pages from the last quarter, because the user asked for current prices.

competitor_prices_eur.note: List prices that the fetched pages state (pass-1 result), in the order of competitor_names. Fictional.

unit_cost_eur.note: Fully loaded cost per seat per month from a table in the user's Q3 report (RAG chunk). Fictional.

pass1_preamble.value: I will check the current list prices first.
pass1_preamble.note: Short visible text the model writes in its response channel before the pass-1 tool call.

chart_path.note: File the pass-2 code writes; the sandbox returns it as an artifact (RA-30).

chart_file_id.note: Opaque artifact ID the code executor assigns to the chart file.

pass2_timeout_s.note: timeout_s the model puts in its run_python call (schema maximum 120 s).

tool_exec_limits._about: Per-call limits the orchestrator applies in the tool loop (Part 06.2, 06.3). They fit RA-11 (deadlines), RA-12 (retries) and RA-32 (approval).

web_search_deadline_s.note: Deadline for one web_search call, search plus page fetches; smaller than the 120 s request deadline (RA-11).

run_python_deadline_margin_s.note: Extra time beyond the call's timeout_s for sandbox restore and result upload, so the executor deadline = timeout_s + this margin.

tool_calls_per_user_per_minute.note: Per-user token bucket for tool calls (step 5 of the loop); separate from the request rate limit of Part 03.

max_parallel_calls_per_pass.note: Most tool calls of one pass that the orchestrator runs at the same time; more calls wait for a free slot.

approval_wait_s.note: How long a side-effecting call waits for the user's approval before it returns a 'not approved' tool result.

broker_token_ttl_s.note: Lifetime of the access token the credential broker hands to an executor for one call (RA-31).
